data.lede: Recognizing influential contributions across generations of hantavirus research.

data.heading: Two awards presented at each triennial meeting.
data.introduction: The ISH lectureship awards recognize scientific leadership, innovation and sustained service to the hantavirus field.

items.title: Joel M. Dalrymple Memorial Award
items.description: Recognizes an outstanding early- to mid-career investigator for innovative contributions to hantavirus research.
items.historical_note: Earlier conference materials list this lectureship as the Joel M. Dalrymple Award.

items.title: Lee Ho Wang Lifetime Achievement Award
items.description: Honors a senior investigator for exceptional and sustained contributions to the field.
items.historical_note: Earlier conference materials list this lectureship as the Ho Wang Lee Award.
